verdict.rationale: Foreloop has fixed, built-in event-driven behaviours: connecting a repo triggers automatic product reviews on pull requests, pushes or an `@foreloop retest` comment re-run the check, admins can opt into a failure threshold, and agents poll for approved tasks on a cadence. There is no evidence of a general user-defined rule engine for mapping events to actions, and approval is a deliberate manual gate before anything runs. Missing for 10: user-authored event→action rules, configurable triggers and conditions beyond the PR-check threshold, webhooks or event subscriptions, independent corroboration.
